targets.authors: Daoust, Jean-François., Alain-G. Gagnon and Thomas Galipeau
targets.title: Language Matters: The Study of Canadian Politics through an Exploration of Syllabi and Comprehensive Exams.
targets.evidence_quote: To replicate and expand on Daoust et al.’s (2022) study, we created two datasets.
targets.outcome_quote: While Daoust et al. reported a stark absence of francophone scholars in core course materials, our study confirms and quantifies this gap while suggesting a significant, though less extreme, under-representation.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly confirm the original gap; its smaller magnitude and differing baseline projections do not override this overall comparison.

reasoning: New syllabi and faculty datasets retest the published claim of francophone underrepresentation. Other cited works supply background rather than additional replication targets.
